lines.text: It once belonged to humanity, but now, only the roar of Raptures echoes across it.
there are always those who venture to the surface to hold the front lines.
In the blink of an eye, a Rapture attack strikes the two of them,
sending them tumbling across the sand.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: These guys are a lot tougher than they look.
Maxwell looks behind her and sees...
An enormous Rapture with one leg raised, ready to finish her off.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: ... Is this as far as I go?
they squeeze their eyes shut, bracing for the Rapture's attack.
Red threads come into view, binding the Rapture's legs.
At the end of the threads, a black wing unfurls.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Is it really that hard to take down a single Rapture?
Four shadows land on the ground.
As the dust settles, their forms slowly come into view.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: I suppose it's only right that I answer!

lines.speaker: gregre
lines.text: To fulfill our purpose in this world.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: To show this world just how cool villains can be!

lines.speaker: gregre
lines.text: Spreading love, devotion, and darkness wherever we go.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: The great villain Drake has arrived!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: What was that at the end there...?
I figured she'd be disappointed if I didn't.
Raptures are closing in on the Villain Union from all sides.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Run wild and wreak havoc your way.
The moment she finishes speaking, the villains move as one.
The tide of battle turns in an instant.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Excellent, villains. I would expect no less from my minion—
A Rapture launches a surprise attack,
but a great villain would never fall for that.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Attacking me while I'm talking? What a coward.
The enormous Rapture lands with a heavy thud.
Drake steps forward and stands alone before it.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Hehe, coming straight at me, are you?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Instead of running away, you come right up to me.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: You'd better be ready for what's coming.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: the true power of the great villain Drake!
Dark red electricity swirls around Drake's body.
The dark red electricity streaks toward the Rapture.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I heard you took down a colossal Rapture headed this way with a single blow.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: That's amazing! How'd you do it?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You protected this whole place all by yourself...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I wish I could become a strong hero like you—

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: I'm not a hero! I'm a villain!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: D-do you think I could become a villain...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Ugh... Just look at that smug little face.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Agh... As much as it pains me to admit it,
The great villain leaps onto the table, her cape billowing behind her.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: I was already mighty, but now I've powered up!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: No one can stand against me!

lines.speaker: gregre
lines.text: ... This is what a great villain looks like.
How long has she waited for this moment?
She can't put into words how she feels.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: That's it! Shout even louder, you ignorant fools!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Call out the name of your great and mighty villain!
Just as the excitement reaches its peak...
Something grabs her by the back of the neck.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: You traitor! Who put you up to this?!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Hey, are you even listening to me?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: How dare you speak that way to the great villain Drake!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Whatever. Just follow me before I get really pissed off.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: You fool... Where do you think you're taking me?
I'm sure she means to lead you to victory, Drake.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Oh, so that's what you meant.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Not a bad goal, I must say. Well done, Ziz.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Before that, I need to teach you how to show proper respect to your leader—

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Ughhh...! Get up! Get up! I said get up!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: A Heretic ambush? Give me a break.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Do you have any idea how long I've been trying to wake you?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Wipe the drool off your face before you talk.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: What happened to the Villain Union?!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Where did all my fame and glory go?!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Say one more word, and I'm reporting you to Syuen.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Get up. We have to go before it gets any later.
Drake gestures, asking where they're headed.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: You're not doing this just because I said I'd report you to Syuen, are you?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: *Sigh* I told you yesterday we have a meeting this morning.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: If I keep talking to you, I'm gonna start losing my mind too.
Drake looks down at her hands.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: ... So it was all a dream?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: I've got a good feeling about this.
